acceptanceText: Add move/rotate/duplicate/delete, typed coordinates, snap/grid, alignment, and dimensions.
title: Scene edit operations — pure op module + canvas wiring at the O-034/O-038/O-039/O-040 seams (candidate-only)

apply.note: NEW file — remote exists:false at recheck HEAD fe0e913da (remote-recheck.json). Imports only ./foundationLayoutModel, ./foundationSceneTransforms, ./foundationSceneInput, ./foundationSceneSelection — all remote and byte-identical to the pull baseline. Whole-file write, LF, terminal LF.

Superset of remote (508→1088 lines): preserves every O-034/O-038/O-039/O-040 seam byte-for-byte in behavior — same drag begin/move/commit flow, same nudge path, same selection/marquee/click rules, same recordEdit history recording — and adds the O-035 surface: selection handles, handle-resize/rotate gestures, ops toolbar, typed bar, snap guides, multi-drag, keyboard rotate/duplicate, delete/duplicate hook routing. New optional props (sceneSelection, onDeleteSelection, onDuplicateSelection, onPatchScene, objectSnap, snapToleranceInches, gridSnapInches) all default-safe; remote callers passing only items/poles/onMoveItem keep working unchanged. Whole-file write is simplest given the diff size.

deployTogether: foundationSceneEditOps imports layoutModel + transforms + input + selection (all remote, unchanged); the canvas imports the edit-ops module + foundationFtInEntry (remote O-093). Both files must land together or the estimator bundle breaks (FoundationEstimator imports the canvas). Import DAG acyclic: layoutModel/transforms/selection <- input <- editOps <- canvas.

operations.move: moveSelectionPatch(scene, ids, delta, opts) — translates every resolved target (items corners, poles points, wall vertices — malformed authored wall vertices ride verbatim, never NaN'd, never repaired). opts.snap (object candidates, tolInches) adjusts the delta onto selection-bounds probes (edges+centers); opts.gridStepInches snaps unsnapped axes to a uniform grid (object snap always outranks grid). round:true at commit.
operations.resize: beginItemResize(item, handle, grabPoint) + resizeItemFromHandle(session, planPoint, opts) — 8-handle resize in the item's rotated local frame; the opposite edge/corner anchors so a handle flip grows the rect (drag past anchor) instead of collapsing; minInches clamp keeps the anchor edge fixed; pillars resize as diameter about the fixed center; corner drags preserve aspect when opts.lockAspect. itemResizePatch = one-shot wrapper used by keyboard paths.
operations.rotate: beginItemRotate(item, grabPoint) + rotateItemFromPointer(session, planPoint, {free}) — rotation about the footprint center, snapped to ROTATE_SNAP_DEGREES (15°) unless Shift frees it; rotateItemBy/rotateItemTo for keyboard ([/]) and toolbar steps; degrees normalize to [0,360).
operations.align: alignSelectionPatch(scene, ids, edge, opts) — ALIGN_EDGES = left/centerX/right/top/centerZ/bottom; to='primary' (default for 2+ targets — primary anchors, others translate) or to='plan' (single target or explicit — plan edge/center lines). Rows already on the line produce no patch (noop, not a fake patch).
operations.distribute: distributeSelectionPatch(scene, ids, axis, opts) — >=3 targets, equal edge gaps along x or z, outermost pair anchored, deterministic (center,id) sort.
operations.typed: typedItemPatch(item, fields) / typedPolePatch(pole, fields) — atomic: ANY unknown/inapplicable/non-finite/non-positive field rejects the WHOLE op (unknown-field, field-not-applicable, invalid-field, non-positive); pillar diameter vs rect length/width enforced; rotation normalizes; coordinates accept any finite value (off-plan is authored data, not a syntax error). The canvas parses ft/in text upstream via foundationFtInEntry (O-093 boundary) — this layer sees canonical inches.
operations.delete: deleteSelectionPlan(scene, idsOrEntries) — pure descriptor: whole-row removals + skipped (sub-objects like wall-segment/pole-sign, unresolved ids, locked rows). requiresConfirm:true — the canvas emits it to onDeleteSelection; business deletion stays page-owned.
operations.duplicate: duplicateSelectionPlan(scene, idsOrEntries) — pure descriptor: whole-row sources + suggested +12/+12 offset. Id minting/clone/remap stays with foundationDuplicateMirror (inspected, untouched) — the canvas emits it to onDuplicateSelection.
operations.snap: snapDraggedItem (single-drag bounds assist), snapBoundsDelta (shared probes/winner rule), snapCandidatesOutside (candidates for the scene minus moving rows). Guides ride every result for the canvas's guide lines.
operations.dimensions: itemPlanGeometry/wallPlanGeometry bounds + planBoundsOfItem/planBoundsOfPole/planBoundsOfWall + targetsBounds feed the selection-outline dims chip and typed fields; footprint dims ride the O-030 foundationLayoutFootprint validation (nonpositive/missing dims render as the existing invalid-note, never a phantom rect).

commitChannels.router: commitOpPatches(op, method, patches) — patchesFitSingleItemChannel → one items-row patch rides the existing onMoveItem/patchItem path (free single-row undo); anything else routes the optional onPatchScene multi channel; no channel → 'unavailable' so a partial application can never happen silently. commit-refused propagates the page's refusal — nothing records.
commitChannels.patchShape: { collection: 'items'|'poles'|'walls'|'wall_caps'|'signage_cabinets', index, key, before, patch } — before = the same fields pre-op (the undo inverse), patch = the merge the page applies.
commitChannels.singleItemUndo: identical to O-040 — recordEdit with target {key,index}; the page's patchItem undo apply round-trips it today.
commitChannels.multiUndo: editRecordForPatches emits kind 'scene-multi', target NULL, before/after each { multi: [{collection,index,fields}] }. target:null is the honesty guard — the current single-row apply reads rev.target.index, throws, and the store reports 'rejected' with stacks untouched (verified in model + browser). The mounted multi apply branches on entry.kind/rev.patch.multi and never touches target.
commitChannels.strokeRule: every op = one undo command: recordEdit for single-row ops (same as O-040), beginStroke+commitStroke wrapping the multi payload for multi-row ops, coalesceKey for keyboard bursts (nudge + rotate]key).

validation.finite: fin() gates every numeric input — NaN/Infinity/non-number deltas, points, fields, steps all reject or null rather than emitting NaN geometry.
validation.nonDegenerate: foundationLayoutFootprint + itemPlanGeometry reject missing/nonpositive dims; resize clamps to minInches and keeps the anchor; typed rejects non-positive dims; degenerate drag sessions return null sessions.
validation.lockedReadOnly: resolveOpTargets honors opts.isLocked per row (skipped, reported) and opts.readOnly for the whole op; the canvas gates all edit chrome on editable (onMoveItem present) and honors item.locked === true via the default isLocked.
validation.verbatimWallVertices: malformed authored wall points (non-finite x/z) are preserved verbatim through translate ops — never NaN'd into the patch, never silently repaired.

canvasSurface.handles: 8 resize handles + 1 rotate handle render only on the primary selected item while editable; cursors map to the handle compass.
canvasSurface.toolbar: ops toolbar appears when editable && count>=1 — 6 align edges, distribute x/z (needs 3+), rotate ±15°, duplicate, delete — each button disabled+explained when its channel isn't mounted.
canvasSurface.typedBar: single-item selection shows x/z/length|width|diameter/rotation fields; Enter or blur commits through typedItemPatch atomically; ft/in text parses via the O-093 boundary; Escape restores the stored text; invalid text never lands a half-patch.
canvasSurface.guides: snap guides render as plan lines (data-snap-guide) during move/resize previews; a transient preview chip announces the pending commit.
canvasSurface.keyboard: arrows nudge (O-039 coalesced), [/] rotate ±15° (Shift ±45°), Ctrl+D duplicate, Delete/Backspace → delete hook, Tab/arrows cycle + Esc clears (O-034), Shift frees snap.
canvasSurface.dimsChip: selected items show live dims (⌀ diameter for pillars, W × D ft/in otherwise) that track preview resizes.

deferredWiring.reason: FoundationEstimator.jsx is ownership-protected — not modified in this unit; the canvas's new props are all optional so the remote mount keeps working without wiring.
anchors: Stores + props: pass the page-owned sceneHistory + sceneSelection stores (O-040/O-034 anchors) plus onPatchScene, onDeleteSelection, onDuplicateSelection at the existing <FoundationLayoutCanvas> mount.
Multi channel: onPatchScene(patches) applies each {collection,index,patch} merge through the page's commit path; returns false to refuse.

Multi-aware undo: the page's undo apply branches on rev.patch.multi / entry.kind==='scene-multi' (applies {collection,index,fields} per row) BEFORE touching rev.target — target is null by design for multi entries.
Full-domain anchor: undo/redo/observe use sceneLayoutAnchor({items, poles, walls}) — the canvas observes in that domain now so single and multi entries chain together.
Delete: onDeleteSelection(entries) → confirm → remove the addressed rows via the page's existing delete path (plan.removals carry collection+index+componentId).
Duplicate: onDuplicateSelection(plan) → foundationDuplicateMirror.duplicateFoundationAssembly handles clone/remap/id-minting with plan.sources + plan.offset_inches.
Snap prefs: objectSnap / snapToleranceInches / gridSnapInches props map to user prefs; Shift frees snap per gesture.
deferredWiring.effectUnwired: without the new props the canvas still move/nudge/selects exactly as remote does (all O-035 ops remain available on the single-row channel where they fit — one selected item's resize/rotate/typed edits record and undo today); align/distribute/multi ops disable honestly with 'requires multi channel' hints.
